description: This PHP source file defines the EmailConfigurationModel class, which serves as a data model for email configuration settings within the OrangeHRM admin API. It includes properties for mail type, sender address, SMTP host, port, username, authentication type, and security type. The class uses traits for serialization and implements normalization interfaces, facilitating the conversion of EmailConfiguration entity data into API responses.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class representing email configuration data for the OrangeHRM admin API, providing serialization and normalization support for EmailConfiguration entities.
